question: How should the ground area defined by width and walls be increased?
premises: The ground area related to width and walls is established.
It is increased by half-and-half increments.
inference: After setting the width-wall ground, one should expand it by successive half increments.
uncertainties: The precise technical meaning of ardha-ardha-vivardhana is ambiguous.
plain_english: Having established the ground area according to width and walls, one should increase it by half-and-half increments.
